name: ProviderAppMetadata
description: Provider-specific configuration that extends the standard OAuth flow.

authQueryParams.description: Additional query parameters to include in the OAuth authorization URL (e.g., optional_scope for HubSpot).

providerParams.description: Provider-specific string values keyed by names (e.g., packageInstallURL for Salesforce, gcpProjectId and gcpPubSubTopicName for Gmail).
